تتراشقي (form VI)
# تَتَرَاشَقِي (tatarāšaqī) /ta.ta.raː.ʃa.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# تُتَرَاشَقِي (tutarāšaqī) /tu.ta.raː.ʃa.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
